examples.name: Colorful Badge
examples.description: We preset a series of colorful Badge styles for use in different situations. You can also set it to a hex color string for custom color.
examples.code:
import React from 'react';
import { Badge, Divider, Space } from 'antd';

const colors = [
  'pink',
  'red',
  'yellow',
  'orange',
  'cyan',
  'green',
  'blue',
  'purple',
  'geekblue',
  'magenta',
  'volcano',
  'gold',
  'lime',
];

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <>
    <Divider titlePlacement="start">Presets</Divider>
    <Space vertical>
      {colors.map((color) => (
        <Badge key={color} color={color} text={color} />
      ))}
    </Space>
    <Divider titlePlacement="start">Custom</Divider>
    <Space vertical>
      <Badge color="#f50" text="#f50" />
      <Badge color="rgb(45, 183, 245)" text="rgb(45, 183, 245)" />
      <Badge color="hsl(102, 53%, 61%)" text="hsl(102, 53%, 61%)" />
      <Badge color="hwb(205 6% 9%)" text="hwb(205 6% 9%)" />
    </Space>
  </>
);

export default App;
